description: A fictional compact rapid-fire carbine game prop for a cave scout, chunky low-poly, held level with the muzzle forward. One short boxy muted olive painted receiver with wide chamfers and one raised olive band around its middle. At the front one short thick dark steel barrel collar and one fat round dark steel muzzle tube with a thick rim and a dark round opening. Along the receiver top one plain thick charcoal top bar with two big blocky charcoal sight blocks, one at each end. Under the receiver one long straight charcoal magazine with four wide horizontal ribs hanging straight down just ahead of the trigger guard; one squared olive trigger guard with a thick charcoal trigger; one chunky charcoal pistol grip raked back with big diagonal ribs and a fat olive base cap. At the rear one open stock of two thick dark steel struts, a straight top strut and a diagonal lower strut, meeting a fat tall charcoal butt pad. One small rectangular teal lamp window in a thick raised charcoal bezel on the left flank of the receiver band above the magazine.
proportions: About 0.62 m long, 0.09 m wide and 0.34 m tall. (length : width : height = 6.89 : 1 : 3.78)
sides: only the teal lamp window is on one flank: on the LEFT flank of the receiver's raised band above the magazine; the right flank is plain olive. The barrel, the muzzle, the top bar and its two sight blocks, the magazine, the trigger guard, the grip, the two stock struts and the butt pad are on the centre line (symmetric left to right).
